text:
Substations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document lists equipment inspection 
checklist I1, which must be performed on an annually bases as indicated by Y1 in 
the above title block.
The first 
draft initiated & tested at 22 Jan 2004 by eng Abdel Rahman Hassan Abdel Rahman 
Seiody at Cairo North 220kv substation, accepted by eng Ahmed Shelaby Faisal 
General Director, and approved by eng Samir Saleh; EHV Network Head Sector Cairo 
zone EETCo.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued, 
the qualified maintenance staff should
 carry the suitable safety category,
Wear your safety helmet, 
 safety shoes .... etc
Switch off the CB.
The opening mechanism should be secured against unintentional movement.
The control voltage supply lines should be disconnected.
Tools and Equipment
Safety helmet & safety shoes.
Portable air blower.
Torque wrenches.
Screw driver with extension spec.
Filter's Hammer,
 Cotter pin driver.
Benz assembly tool.
Work to be Carried Out
Recorded the No. of operation.
Check SF6 gas leakage.
Check the cable connections.
Clean the fingers contact by tighten all loose connection.
Check for operating mechanism (open - close - open)
Lubricate the moving part.
Check the mechanical interlock.
Check screw connections for tightness when tightening loose 
 connections replace washers & tension elements.
